claims: Kyle Whittingham is the head coach of the University of Michigan football program.
Kyle Whittingham was named to the head coach position of the University of Michigan football program on December 26, 2025.
Kyle Whittingham previously spent 21 seasons as the head coach at Utah.
Dusty May is the head coach of the Michigan men's basketball team.
Dusty May was hired as head coach of the Michigan men's basketball team in March 2024.
Dusty May led the Wolverines to an NCAA championship in his second season.
Kim Barnes Arico is the head coach of the Michigan women's basketball team
